newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Dec palm oil output seen 630,000t -Ivan.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Dec palm oil output seen 630,000t -Ivan.

text.p: Malaysia's palm oil output in December is estimated at 630,000 tonnes against 762,540 tonnes in November, crop forecaster Ivan Wong said on Tuesday.
Wong put end-December palm oil stocks at 805,000 tonnes, compared with the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority's (PORLA) 955,965 tonnes at end-November.
Exports in December is estimated at 680,000 tonnes against PORLA's 632,441 tonnes in November.
Wong said in a report that the performance of major producers/millers ranged from down 10 to 23 percent. In East Malaysia, the range was even wider- from about unchanged to down 25 percent, he added.
Total exports in 1996 are estimated at 7.235 million tonnes, a strong increase of 722,000 tonnes or 11 percent over the previous year.
Stocks of PK/PKO were also drawn down sharply by some 35,000 tonnes to around 130,000 tonnes oil basis, because of reduced output and good offtake.
Malaysia of January 14, 1997. (All figures in '000 tonnes)
